questions.q: What is the fundamental difference between point-to-site (P2S) VPN and site-to-site VPN?
options: P2S connects a single device directly into a VNet/VPC; site-to-site connects an entire on-prem network
P2S is only available on AWS, while site-to-site is only available on Azure
P2S never uses encryption, while site-to-site always does
There is no real difference -- they are two names for the same connection type
questions.explain: Site-to-site VPN links whole networks together; point-to-site VPN connects one individual device, like a laptop, directly into the cloud network.

questions.q: What client application does a remote user typically use to establish a point-to-site connection to Azure?
options: The Azure VPN Client (or an OS built-in client using a supported protocol like OpenVPN or IKEv2)
The Azure VNet peering tool
The Local Network Gateway console
The AWS Client VPN application
questions.explain: The Azure VPN Client (or a compatible OS VPN client) is used to connect to an Azure VPN Gateway configured for point-to-site connections.

questions.q: What is AWS's equivalent service to Azure's point-to-site VPN?
options: AWS Client VPN
AWS Direct Connect
AWS Transit Gateway
AWS Virtual Private Gateway
questions.explain: AWS Client VPN is an endpoint that individual remote users' OpenVPN-based clients connect to, authenticated via certificates, Active Directory, or federated SSO.

questions.q: What specific problem does point-to-site VPN solve that site-to-site VPN does not?
options: Giving an individual remote employee direct access to private cloud resources without first connecting through a full office VPN or being on the corporate network
Connecting two cloud VNets to each other over the provider's backbone
Providing a dedicated physical circuit that bypasses the public internet
Allowing an entire on-prem network to reach a VNet using private IP addresses
questions.explain: P2S lets a single remote device reach private cloud resources directly, without the extra hop through an office network via site-to-site VPN.

questions.q: Once connected via point-to-site VPN, how does the remote laptop behave with respect to the cloud network?
options: It behaves, for that session, as if it had a private IP address inside the cloud network
It can only reach publicly exposed endpoints, the same as any other internet user
It must still route all traffic through the on-prem office network first
It establishes a dedicated physical circuit identical to ExpressRoute
questions.explain: Once connected, the device can reach private resources inside the VNet/VPC that aren't exposed to the public internet, as if it held a private IP there.
